title: The mapping index through the lens of the cross-index
summary: We study the cross-index of free \(G\)-posets as a combinatorial analogue of the equivariant topological index. We demonstrate that the cross-index exhibits many structural properties closely paralleling those of the topological index, while its behavior with respect to unions displays a pronounced dichotomy depending on the acting group.
